title: Telemetry configuration
description: The OTEL surface every instrumented process in devops reads. Extended through allOf; never a contract on its own.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: The collector on the private network. Not required: unset, the exporter drops, which is what keeps signoz criticality 4.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: Per-process, so a trace can tell the router from the syncer. Inherited rather than written twice, so the two agree.
